question.text: Hedge Funds in India fall under:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI classifies hedge funds under Category III AIF — funds using diverse/complex trading strategies with leverage. The Trap: Other categories don't accommodate hedge-fund strategies. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with SEBI AIF Regulations 2012. Distributor's Pro-Tip: When explaining Cat III AIFs, use 'hedge fund-like' as a familiar reference for clients.
